mapper.sql: SELECT g.cd_grp_id,g.cd_grp_nm,g.cd_grp_se_cd,g.attr1_nm,g.attr2_nm,g.attr3_nm,g.sort_seq,g.use_yn,(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM cmn.cd_dtl d WHERE d.cd_grp_id=g.cd_grp_id) AS code_count FROM cmn.cd_grp g
mapper.select: SELECT dtl_cd,cd_nm,sort_seq,use_yn,attr1_val,attr2_val,attr3_val,aply_bgn_dt FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group}
mapper.sql: SELECT e.map_id::text,e.excel_lbl_nm,e.trns_cd_grp_id,e.trns_cd,g.cd_grp_nm,d.cd_nm,e.map_role_cd,e.rmrk_desc,e.use_yn FROM cmn.excel_map e JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=e.trns_cd_grp_id JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=e.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=e.trns_cd
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.excel_map WHERE excel_lbl_nm=#{excel_lbl_nm} AND trns_cd_grp_id=#{trns_cd_grp_id} AND trns_cd=#{trns_cd}
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND dtl_cd=#{code} AND use_yn='Y'

SELECT h.chg_at,h.cd_grp_id,CASE WHEN h.cd_grp_id='PARAM' THEN '기준값' ELSE coalesce(g.cd_grp_nm,h.cd_grp_id) END AS cd_grp_nm,h.dtl_cd,h.cd_chg_ty_cd,coalesce(h.item_nm,h.dtl_cd,h.cd_grp_id) AS item_nm,h.bfr_val,h.aft_val,h.chg_user_id FROM cmn.cd_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=h.cd_grp_id ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () p ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(DISTINCT oprt_std_id) FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month}
SELECT oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key}
SELECT oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc,oprt_std_desc,created_by) SELECT oprt_std_id,#{month},oprt_std_nm,#{num},#{text},unit_nm,use_plc_desc,oprt_std_desc,#{userId} FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{sourceMonth} ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET num_val=EXCLUDED.num_val,txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
